notes: Codes come from the Dräger 'MEDIBUS for Intensive Care Devices' IFU tables, NOT from a device at this site.
Run the bridge in discovery mode first; keep only the codes the discovery report actually lists.

Only codes the Homunculus engine has a SignalCode for are mapped. Ventilator mechanics (PEEP 78, Ppeak 7D, MV B9, VTe 88, etCO2 E6) are seen and counted but not forwarded until the engine gains signals for them.
F0 is inspired O2 in percent; the engine's fio2 is a fraction, hence scale 0.01.
E1 pulse and EB SpO2 exist only when the ventilator has its own SpO2 sensor option; otherwise they never appear in the discovery report.

on_resp_support: every successful code-page-1 poll proves the ventilator is on and talking; the bridge emits on_resp_support=1 alongside it. It never emits 0 — absence of data is not evidence of no support.
The bridge ignores 'verified' and 'notes'; they are for the operator.
